stories.name: Anthropic restructures Claude subscription plan — Agent SDK and claude -p removed
stories.notes: Added 2026-05-15 from a real iteration-16 conversation. Surfaced on HN as two items: (1) support.claude.com/articles/15036540 — Anthropic's own support article; (2) xda-developers.com coverage — 'Claude subscriptions no longer include Agent SDK and Claude -p usage'. Originating @ClaudeDevs tweet on X is the canonical source — needs HARVEST_PAID=1 to verify. Concrete worked example for ISC-125-127 (reception layer): the dev community is angry per Kem, but every harvested artifact has neutral or factual phrasing; engagement-as-trending would mis-classify this as 'liked news' when it is 'ratioed news'. expectedType is 'feature' because the change is a specific shift to what the subscription tier provides, not broader-theme news.
